method: breaths by loudness (under -20 dB for 0.3 s, phrases under 1.5 s merged) + text alignment; Whisper: 42 of 49 breaks heard

lines.latin: Te Deum laudámus: te Dóminum confitémur.
lines.english: We praise Thee, O God: we acknowledge Thee to be the Lord.

lines.latin: Te ætérnum Patrem omnis terra venerátur.
lines.english: Thee, the eternal Father, all the earth doth worship.
To Thee all the Angels,
to Thee the heavens and all the Powers,

lines.latin: Tibi Chérubim et Séraphim incessábili voce proclámant:
lines.english: to Thee the Cherubim and Seraphim cry out with unceasing voice:
Holy,
Holy,
Holy, Lord God of hosts.

lines.latin: Pleni sunt cæli et terra majestátis glóriæ tuæ.
lines.english: The heavens and the earth are full of the majesty of Thy glory.
Thee the glorious choir of the Apostles,
Thee the praiseworthy company of the Prophets,
Thee the white-robed army of Martyrs doth praise.

lines.latin: Te per orbem terrárum sancta confitétur Ecclésia:
lines.english: Thee the holy Church throughout the whole world doth confess:
the Father of boundless majesty;

lines.latin: Venerándum tuum verum, et únicum Fílium:
lines.english: Thine adorable, true and only Son;
and the Holy Ghost, the Paraclete.
Thou, O Christ, art the King of glory.
Thou art the everlasting Son of the Father.

lines.latin: Tu ad liberándum susceptúrus hóminem, non horruísti Vírginis úterum.
lines.english: Thou, when Thou wouldst take manhood upon Thee to set man free, didst not shrink from the Virgin's womb.

lines.latin: Tu devícto mortis acúleo, aperuísti credéntibus regna cælórum.
lines.english: Thou, having overcome the sting of death, didst open the kingdom of heaven to them that believe.

lines.latin: Tu ad déxteram Dei sedes, in glória Patris.
lines.english: Thou sittest at the right hand of God, in the glory of the Father.
Thou art believed to be the Judge who shall come.

lines.latin: Te ergo quǽsumus, tuis fámulis súbveni,
lines.english: We beseech Thee, therefore, come to the help of Thy servants,
whom Thou hast redeemed with Thy precious blood.
Make them

lines.latin: cum Sanctis tuis in glória numerári.
lines.english: to be numbered with Thy Saints in glory everlasting.
Save Thy people, O Lord,
and bless Thine inheritance.
Rule them,

lines.latin: et extólle illos usque in ætérnum.
lines.english: and lift them up for ever.
Every day we bless Thee.

lines.latin: Et laudámus nomen tuum in sǽculum, et in sǽculum sǽculi.
lines.english: And we praise Thy name for ever, and for ever and ever.

lines.latin: Dignáre Dómine die isto sine peccáto nos custodíre.
lines.english: Deign, O Lord, to keep us this day without sin.
Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us.

lines.latin: Fiat misericórdia tua Dómine super nos,
lines.english: Let Thy mercy, O Lord, be upon us,
as we have hoped in Thee.
In Thee, O Lord, have I hoped:
let me not be confounded for ever.

lines.latin: Benedicámus Patrem et Fílium cum Sancto Spíritu.
lines.english: Let us bless the Father and the Son, with the Holy Ghost.

lines.latin: Laudémus et superexaltémus eum in sǽcula.
lines.english: Let us praise and exalt Him above all for ever.

lines.latin: Benedíctus es Dómine in firmaménto cæli.
lines.english: Blessed art Thou, O Lord, in the firmament of heaven.

lines.latin: Et laudábilis, et gloriósus, et superexaltátus in sǽcula.
lines.english: And worthy to be praised, and glorious, and exalted above all for ever.
O Lord, hear my prayer.

lines.latin: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
lines.english: And let my cry come unto Thee.
Let us pray.

lines.latin: Deus cujus misericórdiæ non est númerus, et bonitátis infinítus est thesáurus:
lines.english: O God, whose mercies are without number, and the treasure of whose goodness is infinite:

lines.latin: piísimæ Majestáti tuæ pro collátis donis grátias ágimus, tuam semper cleméntiam exorántes:
lines.english: we give thanks to Thy most gracious Majesty for the gifts Thou hast bestowed, ever beseeching Thy clemency,

lines.latin: ut qui peténtibus postuláta concédis, eósdem non déserens, ad prǽmia futúra dispónas.
lines.english: that as Thou grantest the petitions of them that ask Thee, Thou wilt not forsake them, but wilt prepare them for the rewards to come.
Through Christ our Lord.
Amen.
